title: Automatically Closed Newest First
description: The sidebar's Automatically Closed section now lists the most recently closed tab first, both on load and after a storage change (e.g. removing a row), and group headings follow by each group's most recent close. The filter-and-sort moved out of Tabs' mount effect into a pure, tested `sortAutoClosed(autoClosed, now)` util, and a Tabs repro test pins the rendered order (confirmed red against the old ascending sort). Scenario upkeep: Home - Automatically Closed's fixed timestamps had aged past the 5-day retention window and rendered empty, so they were shifted forward (order and gaps preserved); isolated Tabs scenarios rendered as a bare footer because the isolate harness gave the full-height rail no height, so the harness now frames Tabs at viewport height. Added Tabs - Auto Closed Newest First and Tabs - Auto Closed Newest First After Removal (clicks the newest row's remove control). Scope verdict: all 8 plan deliverables delivered, none deferred (status recorded by the agent, not separately confirmed by the user). Known follow-up, out of scope: scenarios seed absolute close timestamps, so auto-closed scenarios will age out of the retention window again within ~5 days; headings split across interleaved runs remain as before.
